about: Shared known-answer vectors for Phase 2 (docs/impl/phase2-spec.md §6.11). Read-only for every work package; generated by gen/kat.mjs, change the spec before changing them. Byte strings are lower-case hex (_hex) or unpadded base64url (_b64url); u64 values that do not fit a double are decimal strings.

test_keys.about: P-256 test keys: d = (SHA-256(label) mod (n - 1)) + 1. Their signatures here use RFC 6979 nonces; consumers verify them and never need d

accepted_epochs.formula: e = floor(now_ms / 86400000), d = now_ms - e*86400000; accept e; also e-1 iff d <= 605000 (600 s interactive lifetime + 5 s skew); also e+1 iff 86400000 - d <= 5000; one window for every challenge type (spec §6.1, D-42). Replaces the Phase 1 accepted_epochs vectors

ui_params.formula: u = SHA-256('mg-ui-v1' || 0x00 || u64be(ui_seed)); required_hold_ms = 1200 + (u16be(u[0..2]) mod 1301); offset_x_px = (u[2] mod 33) - 16; offset_y_px = (u[3] mod 17) - 8. ui_seed is a decimal string (u64)

pow_v2.formula: prefix2 = 'mg-pow-v2' || 0x00 || SHA-256(C as ASCII) (42 bytes); digest_i = SHA-256(prefix2 || u8(i) || u64be(counter_i)), i = 0..k-1; solved iff every leading_zero_bits(digest_i) >= d and counter_i < 2^53; the canonical counter of each sub-puzzle is the smallest one, searched from 0 (spec §6.4, D-43)

jwk_thumbprint.formula: jkt = base64url_nopad(SHA-256('{"crv":"P-256","kty":"EC","x":"<x>","y":"<y>"}')): RFC 7638 with the members in lexicographic order and no whitespace; 43 characters (spec §6.5)

rfc7638_example.note: RFC 7638 §3.1 (an RSA key): checks the formula only; MorphGate accepts P-256 keys only

es256.formula: ECDSA P-256 with SHA-256; the signature is the 64-byte IEEE P1363 r || s, sent as unpadded base64url (86 characters); DER is rejected; high-S is accepted; the public point is 0x04 || x || y (spec §6.5)

cases.name: valid_high_s
cases.note: the same signature with s replaced by n - s; WebCrypto does not normalize s, so it must be accepted

cases.name: der_encoded
cases.note: the valid signature in DER form: only the 64-byte IEEE P1363 r || s form is accepted

cases.name: point_not_on_curve
cases.note: y + 1: the point is checked when verifying, with the same result as a bad signature

submission_message.formula: 'mg-sub-v2' || 0x00 || lp(c) || lp(type) || lp(p) || lp(H(pp)) || lp(H(t)) || lp(counters) || lp(ret) || u64be(ts) || lp(build); lp(x) = u16be(len(x)) || x; H = SHA-256 over the UTF-8 bytes of the string fields pp and t (empty when absent); counters = decimal counters joined by ',' (spec §6.6)

mg_proof.format: MG-Proof = B64(header) '.' B64(payload) '.' B64(sig), unpadded base64url, <= 4096 bytes; header exactly {alg: ES256, typ: mg-proof+jwt, jwk}; payload exactly {htm, htu, iat, jti}; the signature input is the ASCII of B64(header) '.' B64(payload) (spec §6.7)
mg_proof.order: proof.malformed (format, size, JSON with duplicate keys or unknown members, JWK members and lengths) -> proof.unbound (no expected_jkt) -> proof.jkt -> proof.htm (case-sensitive) -> proof.htu (https on both sides; RFC 3986 host without userinfo, normalized like the request host, port compared as is; path before ? or # compared through mg_core::paths::cloudflare_view on both sides) -> proof.iat (now - 30 <= iat <= now + 5) -> proof.sig (64-byte r || s, point on the curve); the first failure is the reason
mg_proof.request_fields: method, scheme and path are the request's (path without the query); host is the normalized request host; expected_jkt is the cnf.jkt of the request's valid clearance, null when there is none

cases.name: valid_dot_segments
cases.note: both paths are compared through mg_core::paths::cloudflare_view, which removes dot segments

cases.name: valid_percent_hex_case
cases.note: cloudflare_view upper-cases the hex digits of escapes it keeps

cases.name: valid_lower_case_patch
cases.note: fetch upper-cases only DELETE GET HEAD OPTIONS POST PUT; a lower-case patch is sent as is

cases.name: htu_host_with_port
cases.note: the port is compared as is; the normalized request host never has one

cases.name: htu_encoded_slash
cases.note: cloudflare_view keeps %2F encoded, so /api%2Fsave is not /api/save

cases.name: htu_raw_non_ascii_path
cases.note: the browser sends /caf%C3%A9; a raw UTF-8 path in htu does not match

cases.name: sig_der
cases.note: well-formed base64url but not 64 bytes: a signature failure, not a format failure

cdata.formula: k_bind = HKDF-SHA256(salt = empty, ikm = root, info = 'mg-bind-v1' || 0x00 || site_id || 0x00 || u64be(epoch of C.kid), 32); cdata = base64url_nopad(HMAC-SHA256(k_bind, 'mg-ts-cdata-v1' || 0x00 || lp(site_id) || lp(nonce))), 43 characters (spec §6.9)

idempotency_key.formula: idempotency_key = uuid_v4_format(SHA-256('mg-ts-idem-v1' || 0x00 || nonce)[0..16]); with the previous secret: uuid_v4_format(SHA-256('mg-ts-idem-v1' || 0x00 || nonce || 0x01)[0..16]); uuid_v4_format sets the high 4 bits of byte 6 to 0100 and the high 2 bits of byte 8 to 10, then prints 8-4-4-4-12 lower-case hex (spec §6.9)

bind_jkt.formula: bind.jkt = bind_hash('jkt', <43-character thumbprint>) = SHA-256('mg-bind-v1' || 0x00 || 'jkt' || 0x00 || jkt)[0..16] (Phase 1 spec §6.4; Phase 2 spec §6.5)
